_meta.description: Word puzzles for iPhone & iPad: Wheel, Search, and Chain share one fair par-based score inside thirteen living worlds that react to what you spell. Generated music, Game Center daily leaderboards, fully offline — no ads, no accounts, no data collection.

completely-the-dictionary-puzzle.d3542c: Completely. The dictionary, puzzle generation, scoring, worlds, and music are all on device, so airplane mode changes nothing. Game Center scores sync up the next time you're online — and signing in is never required to play.

dictionary-puzzle-generation-scoring.fef: Dictionary, puzzle generation, scoring, worlds, and music all live on device. Airplane mode is a perfectly good place to play.

dusk-under-old-growth.5499a4: Dusk under old growth — streaks wake the fireflies.
every-puzzle-carries-a.4ff387: Every puzzle carries a computed par, and your score is your quality against par plus a speed bonus — the same formula in every mode, every world, every level. No theme or setting can buy points. That's what makes the daily leaderboard one competition instead of three.
every-puzzle-is-generated.d8a8a0: Every puzzle is generated with a solver-computed par. Your score is your quality against that par, plus a speed bonus that only multiplies quality — capped at 1,100 points per puzzle, with the identical formula in all three modes. Harder boards allow more time, so nothing about your world, level, or mode choice can tilt the leaderboard.
every-session-composes-itself.fc32c9: Every session composes itself from the world's own recipe: letters walk the scale, a valid word resolves the chord. No two sessions sound alike.
every-world-has-its.9ec5a0: Every world has its own light, its own tiles, and its own generated music — and it listens. Long words pulse the board, streaks build the world's energy, and a word that belongs to the world earns its signature flourish.
felt-piano-and-old.5e5913: Felt piano and old paper. FOLIO earns a flourish.
from-first-ligature-to.dd76ed: From First Ligature to Em Dash to Full Bleed — and yes, playing a word with consecutive r-n in it unlocks one called Keming.
game-center-daily-boards.f94027: Game Center daily boards for each mode, plus a combined board that sums all three. Lifetime scores count in Ems — an em is type's own unit of measure.
gold-sparks-over-the.3a33f0: Gold sparks over the year's last letters.

hushed-snow-cold-blue.55872f: Hushed snow, cold blue light, a touch of red.
is-kern-available-in.54bbc3: Is Kern available in the European Union?
it-s-generated-on.879df5: It's generated on your device — there are no looping tracks. Each world has a recipe (scale, tempo, instruments), your letter selections walk up the scale, and a valid word resolves a chord sized by its length. It honors the silent switch, and you can mix with your own audio from Settings.
kern-isn-t-sold.cefc5d: Kern isn't sold on the App Store in the European Union — under the EU Digital Services Act, selling there requires publishing a trader listing with personal contact details, which I've opted out of as an independent developer. It's also not currently offered in France or China. It's available in every other App Store territory.
kern-v-to-mind.094598: kern (v.) — to mind the space between letters. Mind it poorly and "rn" becomes "m"; around here that's called keming, and yes, there's an achievement for it.
kerning-is-the-typographer.0759ec: Kerning is the typographer's craft of adjusting the space between letter pairs until a word sits perfectly — the most obsessive, invisible detail in type. A word game named Kern promises letter-level care. And if you squeeze the r and n too close together, "kerning" reads as "keming" — which is why playing a word with r-n in it earns an achievement by that name.
leaves-fall-harder-the.7ff17a: Leaves fall harder the longer your words get.
letterpress-tiles-and-ink.09f710: Letterpress tiles and ink — the type nerd's home turf.
no-accounts-no-ads.ed3960: No accounts, no ads, no analytics, no third-party SDKs. Puzzles, scoring, worlds, and music are all computed locally, and the whole game works offline. The only thing that ever leaves is a Game Center score you choose to post.
no-accounts-no-analytics.268b6d: No accounts. No analytics. No third-party SDKs. Nothing leaves your device except the scores you choose to post.
no-reactivity-is-cosmetic.173b6d: No — reactivity is cosmetic by law. Worlds change the light, the tiles, the music, and the flourishes, never the formula. Finding a word that belongs to a world feeds achievements and your per-world journal, not your score.
no-to-both-kern.ebd1db: No to both. Kern is $4.99 once — no ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no data collection. Seasonal worlds arrive as part of the game, not as events or passes.
one-seeded-puzzle-per.324b7e: One seeded puzzle per mode per day — the same boards for everyone on Earth, computed on your device. No server involved, nothing to download.
one-seeded-puzzle-per.d0c0c7: One seeded puzzle per mode per day, derived from the date itself — so the whole world plays the same boards with no server involved. Your first completion per mode posts to that day's Game Center leaderboards, and free play stays endless alongside it.
